description: Public check-in, check-out, early check-in and late check-out options, group, dog, cat, cleaning and event rules. Dogs: no size, weight or breed restriction, may stay alone in the house, one dog per stay without prior approval, beyond one dog agreed case by case. Cats are also welcome. Amounts are EUR minor units; the total is computed on the official booking page. Optional "language" (fr, en, de or nl, default fr): adds a "localized" block with the reviewed site wording and page URLs in that language. Other fields stay in French.
name: get_stay_rules
title: Stay rules and fees
